description: init writes folkways.yaml with team mode, the angular commit convention and every hook on. From init.test.ts: init > writes folkways.yaml with team mode and every hook on

files.folkways.yaml:
re:(?m)^mode: team\b(?s).*(?m)^  commit_convention: angular\s+# angular \| pattern \| none$(?s).*(?m)^  commit_pattern: ""(?s).*(?m)^hooks:.*
  git-guard: true
  context-band: true
  precompact: true
  session-start: true$

expect.stdout:
Created ${TEAM} with folkways ${VERSION}.
Next: open Claude Code or Copilot CLI in ${TEAM} and run the setup skill.
